concept: EventBridge: content-based event routing to multiple targets
tests: Choosing a service to route events from many AWS services to different targets by content.
expected: Amazon EventBridge: event bus with rules, content-based filtering and many targets. Triggers: "routed to different targets based on the content of events", "many AWS services", "flexible filtering rules".
why_not: SQS only queues, with no rule-based routing; CloudTrail records API calls; CloudWatch dashboards are visualization.
